level_one.title: Reactive Ballistospores
level_one.description: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.  Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.  This effect has a 75 second cooldown.

level_four.title: Biotic Armor
level_four.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: The Long Pitch
level_seven.description: Increase the range of Weighted Pustule by 50%. Detonating 2 or more Weighted Pustules causes Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch and Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Flailing Swipe
level_ten.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

level_thirteen.title: Virulent Reaction
level_thirteen.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Universal Carrier
level_sixteen.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

level_one.title: Party Mix
level_one.description: Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.  Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lucio's maximum Mana by 10.  Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's range by 20%.

level_four.title: Supersonic
level_four.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

level_seven.title: Reverse Amp
level_seven.description: Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.  This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

level_ten.title: Sound Barrier
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: All Together
level_thirteen.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

level_sixteen.title: Rejuvenescência
level_sixteen.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

level_twenty.title: House Party
level_twenty.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

level_one.title: Electric Charge
level_one.description: The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.  While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

level_four.title: Healing Totem
level_four.description: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125 (+4% per level) Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

level_seven.title: Cleanse
level_seven.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on yourself.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Earth Shield
level_thirteen.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Rising Storm
level_sixteen.description: Every time a Lighting Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.  Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Storm Shield
level_twenty.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Bold Strategy
level_one.description: Anduin gains his other level 1 Talents, but Flash Heal's cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Inner Fire
level_four.description: The target of Light Bomb gains 40% Move Speed and 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Blessed Recovery
level_seven.description: If Anduin loses more than 8% of his maximum Health at once, recover 15% Health over 3 seconds.  This effect has a 10 second cooldown.  Current Health required: 133 (+4% per level)

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
level_thirteen.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Lightwell
level_sixteen.description: Summon a Lightwell that periodically heals a nearby allied Hero for 50 (+4% per level). The well only fades after healing 15 times or when recast.  This cooldown is reduced by 1 second each time Anduin heals an allied Hero.

level_twenty.title: Varian's Legacy
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks burn enemies for 87 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds and Anduin heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

level_one.title: Fingers of Frost
level_one.description: Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to increase Jaina's Mana regeneration by 0.1 per second, up to 2 per second.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, the damage bonus from Frostbite is increased by 10%.

level_four.title: Frost Shards
level_four.description: Frostbolt will now pierce the first two targets.

level_seven.title: Ice Lance
level_seven.description: Hitting a Chilled target with Frostbolt reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds and restores 10 Mana.

level_ten.title: Ring of Frost
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

level_thirteen.title: Icy Veins
level_thirteen.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Numbing Blast
level_sixteen.description: Cone of Cold Roots Chilled targets for 1 second.

level_one.title: Unyielding Power
level_one.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Skull Missile.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, increase Skull Missile's damage by 100.  Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Skull Missile gains an additional charge.

level_four.title: Hateful Mending
level_four.description: Skull Missile grants 10 Mana and heals Mephisto for 70% of the damage it deals to Heroes.

level_seven.title: Ghastly Armor
level_seven.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25 Armor while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.

level_ten.title: Consume Souls
level_ten.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Abhorred Skull
level_thirteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Skull Missile grants 25% Spell Power for 6 seconds. Skull Missile deals 40% more damage to Heroes under 50% Health.

level_sixteen.title: Lightning Reaction
level_sixteen.description: Skull Missile explodes on contact with Lightning Nova, dealing 138 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.
